searchText: i read it as reducing validators permanently, sorry. yeah, a scheduled stress test also sounds interesting... I meant it as a one time test, coordinated, to find places where the current code breaks with non-finality at a large scale. Pyrmont is no longer orders of magnitude larger than mainnet and any resource problem in such a test is to be expected in mainnet.
